''See also: [[Mithra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Mithra is the final [[sword]] created by [[Valin|Valin the Wanderer]] and serves as the thirteenth [[Dragon's Fang]]. The weapon features a silver blade with a thin gold line running from the hilt to the tip, and its handle is wrapped in gold. The blade is slightly curved and possesses a sharp edge only on the exterior side, making it distinct from the [[sword]] Azura. Due to its unique nature, only individuals possessing the power of [[Valinhall]] are capable of wielding it. Beyond being a tool for combat, Mithra carries significant weight as the blade of [[Valin]]; whoever inherits the [[sword]] also inherits the duties associated with the [[Founder]] of [[Valinhall]]. The weapon appears to possess a level of agency, as it can choose an heir and will not abandon its previous wielder.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Forged]] by [[Valin|Valin the Wanderer]] as his finest work, Mithra is a golden [[Dragon's Fang]] featuring a silver-and-gold blade with a gold core running up its center. Originally wielded by the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]], this legendary weapon can only be used by those possessing the power of [[Valinhall]]. After a squad of [[Damascan soldiers]] stumbled upon the blade, it eventually chose its thirteenth [[Dragon's Fang]] heir and was held by [[Kai]]. During a confrontation, the [[sword]] turned aside [[Simon]] and Azura, forcing [[Simon]] to knock the blade away during their fight. As an item used by the [[Valinhall Incarnation]], it remains a significant relic of power.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Mithra is the name of a gold-lined [[Dragon's Fang]] [[sword]] once held by the [[Eldest|Eldest Nye]]. Used by [[Kai]], the blade possesses the ability to communicate emotions to its wielder and can be banished within [[the House]]. After [[Kai]] laid the weapon on the ground, it eventually came into the possession of [[Simon]]. Although the [[sword]] remains quiet at times, [[Simon]] is able to summon it. Feeling both resigned and eager, Mithra was used by [[Simon]] to strike [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]].}}
